categories.main_business_segments: Ginlong Technologies operates primarily in two core business segments: (1) photovoltaic (PV) inverters, including grid-connected inverters and energy storage inverters, which are the company's main product line; and (2) distributed photovoltaic power generation, including commercial/industrial and residential rooftop solar systems, as well as household photovoltaic power generation system services. The company also provides comprehensive solar power generation solutions and services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in string inverter technology with advanced features including maximum power point tracking (MPPT), high-efficiency conversion circuits, DC arc detection, anti-harmonic resonance control algorithms, and intelligent power factor control. Core technologies include SiC semiconductor materials, high-efficiency magnetic components, DSP processors, and advanced control algorithms. The company has developed six generations of inverter technology platforms and employs manufacturing processes including component procurement, assembly, testing, and quality control through an ERP system.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include photovoltaic system integrators, installation contractors, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) contractors, and end-user investors in both residential and commercial sectors. The company serves utility companies and grid operators for grid-connected systems. Major end markets include distributed photovoltaic systems for residential users, commercial and industrial rooftops, and utility-scale ground-mounted installations across multiple geographic regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in China (domestic market), Europe (UK, Netherlands, Germany), Australia, Mexico, India, United States, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and other regions. The company has established sales and service offices in multiple provinces within China and maintains overseas subsidiaries including operations in Australia (SOLIS AUSTRALASIA), Hong Kong, USA, and Vietnam. International markets represent a substantial portion of revenue, with 43.24% of 2024 revenue from overseas regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ginlong Technologies operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the photovoltaic supply chain. The company manufactures and sells inverters (midstream component supplier) and develops, constructs, and operates distributed photovoltaic power stations (downstream energy producer). The company controls the complete value chain from inverter manufacturing through to power generation and distribution, positioning itself as both a critical equipment supplier and energy producer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technology innovation with focus on next-generation inverter platforms, energy storage solutions, and smart grid integration. R&D initiatives include developing 2000VDC high-voltage inverters, advanced energy storage systems, AI-based arc detection, silicon carbide (SiC) MOSFET applications, and virtual synchronous machine technology. The company emphasizes product efficiency improvements, cost reduction, enhanced reliability, and expansion into emerging markets. Strategic focus includes strengthening distributed energy management capabilities and developing integrated photovoltaic-storage solutions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple streams: (1) direct sales of photovoltaic inverters to system integrators, contractors, and end-users; (2) electricity sales from owned and operated distributed photovoltaic power stations to grid companies and commercial customers; (3) service revenue from household photovoltaic system design, installation, management, operation, and maintenance. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods or services to customers, with different recognition timing for product sales versus power generation services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ginlong Technologies is positioned as a leading global manufacturer of string inverters and distributed photovoltaic solutions. The company competes with major international inverter manufacturers and is recognized as a Tier 1 global photovoltaic inverter manufacturer by Bloomberg NEF. The company has been consecutively awarded 'Top-tier Photovoltaic Inverter Brand' by EuPD Research for ten years. The company differentiates through superior product reliability, advanced technology, global brand recognition, and integrated photovoltaic-storage solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total revenue of 6.542 billion yuan, representing 7.23% growth compared to 2023 (6.101 billion yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 691.16 million yuan, down 11.32% year-over-year. The company maintains substantial assets of 21.05 billion yuan and shareholders' equity of 8.32 billion yuan. Operating cash flow improved significantly to 2.051 billion yuan in 2024 from 383.04 million yuan in 2023. The company demonstrates solid financial position with consistent profitability and strong cash generation capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ginlong Technologies differentiates through superior inverter efficiency (up to 99.1%), advanced reliability features, comprehensive product portfolio spanning residential to utility-scale applications, and integrated photovoltaic-storage solutions. The company emphasizes technological innovation, product quality, and customer service excellence. Key differentiators include proprietary MPPT algorithms, DC arc detection technology, weak-grid adaptation capabilities, and comprehensive monitoring platforms. The company's integrated business model combining inverter manufacturing with power station operation provides customers with complete energy solutions and long-term operational expertise.
